data_fields.name: objective_need
data_fields.donor_constant: RequiredNpcOrGoCount[j] (count per creature or game-object objective)

data_fields.name: time_allowed_s
data_fields.donor_constant: TimeAllowed, multiplied by IN_MILLISECONDS when accepted

data_fields.name: timer_fail_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: fail when remaining timer is at or below the elapsed time; timer kept in ms

data_fields.name: event_window_cycle
data_fields.donor_constant: Occurence, in minutes (the header comment does not state the unit; the formula multiplies by MINUTE)

data_fields.name: waypoint_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: delay column per waypoint point (unit not read)

best_idea: Keep each player's quest progress as one small record per quest with per-objective counts capped at the need, a timed quest as a millisecond countdown on the server tick that fails at zero, and a giver marker that is just the highest state among that giver's quests.
decision_why: Capped per-objective counts, one objective per kill, the tick countdown and the highest-wins marker fit quest rows and one server ledger; the donor's per-path progress writes are rejected, and its gaps (zero timer accepted, unit of game-event cycle unstated, bound items fixed by code) are fixed as row fields.
acceptance: A server test: a kill quest needing 3 of one creature, given 5 kills, counts 3 and completes once; a 1000 ms timed quest fails on the tick that passes 1000 ms and destroys its bound item; a giver shows marker 10 when one of its quests is complete and not rewarded, even if another is incomplete.
